facts.business: Urja Global Limited is engaged in business operations generating revenue of Rs. 59.24 crore standalone and Rs. 67.59 crore consolidated in FY 2025-26, with investments in mines projects classified as capital work in progress.

capacity_or_capex.item: Investment in Mines Projects (Capital Work in Progress)

auditor.name: Not explicitly stated in excerpts
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Qualified opinion due to: (A) Non-reversal of GST Input Tax Credit of approx Rs.34.25 Lakhs against dues due to non-payment to sundry creditors within stipulated time under CGST Act; (B) No documentary evidence for Investment in Mines Projects (Rs.46.35 crore capital work in progress) and Loans & Advances granted, as records were seized during GST department raid on 20-07-2021, making recoverability and carrying value impact indeterminable.

key_risks: GST compliance risk: Non-reversal of Input Tax Credit of Rs.34.25 Lakhs due to delayed creditor payments
Documentation and recoverability risk: No documentary evidence for Mines Projects investment (Rs.46.35 crore CWIP) and Loans & Advances due to GST raid seizure of records in July 2021
Regulatory compliance risk: Unable to verify compliance with Companies Act 2013 provisions due to missing documents
Consolidated revenue decline: 1.31% decrease in consolidated revenue in FY 2025-26
Consolidated profit decline: 2.47% decrease in consolidated PAT in FY 2025-26
